mapper.select: SELECT a.co_id, a.co_nm, COALESCE(a.co_eng_nm, '') AS co_eng_nm, COALESCE(a.co_biz_no, '') AS co_biz_no, COALESCE(a.co_no, '') AS co_no, COALESCE(a.co_rep_nm, '') AS co_rep_nm, COALESCE(a.co_ttl_emp_no, 0) AS co_ttl_emp_no, COALESCE(a.co_est_fom, '') AS co_est_fom, COALESCE(to_char(a.co_est_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') AS co_est_dt, COALESCE(a.co_fom, '') AS co_fom, COALESCE(a.co_phn_no, '') AS co_phn_no, COALESCE(a.co_sz_cd, '') AS co_sz_cd, COALESCE(a.co_pals_no, '') AS co_pals_no, COALESCE(a.co_addr, '') AS co_addr, COALESCE(a.co_eml, '') AS co_eml, COALESCE(a.co_hpg_url, '') AS co_hpg_url, COALESCE(a.co_indus, '') AS co_indus, COALESCE(a.co_img_url, '') AS co_img_url, COALESCE(a.co_view_qty, 0) AS co_view_qty, a.cre_usr_id, a.cre_dt, a.upd_usr_id, a.upd_dt, a.co_tp_id, b.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS co_sz_nm, c.co_tp_nm, 1 as no FROM co_mgmt a LEFT JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl b ON ( b.intg_cd = 'CD00009' AND a.co_sz_cd = b.intg_cd_val_ctnt ) LEFT JOIN co_tp_mgmt c ON ( a.co_tp_id = c.co_tp_id ) WHERE a.co_id = #{coId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO co_mgmt ( co_nm, co_eng_nm, co_biz_no, co_no, co_rep_nm, co_ttl_emp_no, co_est_fom, co_est_dt, co_fom, co_phn_no, co_sz_cd, co_pals_no, co_addr, co_eml, co_hpg_url, co_indus, co_img_url, co_view_qty, co_tp_id, cre_usr_id, cre_dt, upd_usr_id, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{coNm}, #{coEngNm}, #{coBizNo}, #{coNo}, #{coRepNm}, #{coTtlEmpNo}, #{coEstFom}, to_timestamp(#{coEstDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{coFom}, #{coPhnNo}, #{coSzCd}, #{coPalsNo}, #{coAddr}, #{coEml}, #{coHpgUrl}, #{coIndus}, (#{coImgUrl} || (SELECT currval('co_mgmt_co_id_seq'))), 0 , #{coTpId}, #{creUsrId}, #{creDt}, #{updUsrId}, #{updDt} )
